questions.prompt_text: Consider the following 3x3 matrix, which represents the RGB values corresponding to Figure I. Convert the RGB value of the first pixel of the matrix into its equivalent HSI (Hue, Saturation, Intensity) and CMY (Cyan, Magenta, Yellow) representations. Justify answer with an appropriate mathematical derivation
questions.criteria: Correct conversion of RGB to HSI and CMY, and proper mathematical derivation
questions.ideal_answer: The RGB value of the first pixel should be converted to HSI and CMY, and the mathematical derivation should be provided

questions.prompt_text: The university office is preparing to scan and store three documents: a black-and-white attendance sheet, a colored event photo, and a student's ID card. The university authority has decided to prepare a report for technical specifications and future reusability. The report should i) explain the different types of digital images that may correspond to the files described above, ii) explain the technique used for representing digital images in computers, and state the commonly used digital image formats suitable for storing and processing each of the above files. Write and prepare the report for the university
questions.criteria: The report should cover the different types of digital images, techniques for representing digital images, and suitable image formats for each document
questions.ideal_answer: A comprehensive report covering the required aspects should be provided

questions.prompt_text: Digital Image Processing consists of five fundamental steps: Image Formation, Image Acquisition, Image Transformation, Feature Selection, and Classification. Briefly explain the core principles of Image Transformation and Feature Selection, and analyze the commonly used techniques and their applications in enhancing image analysis, pattern recognition, and classification tasks associated with these two steps
questions.criteria: The core principles of Image Transformation and Feature Selection should be explained, and the commonly used techniques and their applications should be analyzed
questions.ideal_answer: The explanation should cover the core principles, and the analysis should discuss the techniques and their applications
